title: Route::query and Model defaults in Laravel 13.35
content:
Laravel 13.35 adds Route::query(), an opt-in defaults() method for models, property arrays in fake assertions, percentage worker memory limits, and more.

The post Route::query() and Model defaults() in Laravel 13.35 appeared first on Laravel News.

author: Paul Redmond
